summary.en: Open-source AI coding agent with Windows Arm64 builds of both the CLI and the desktop app.
summary.zh-TW: 開源 AI 程式碼代理，命令列版與桌面版都提供 Windows Arm64 版本。

caveats.en: The release assets include opencode-windows-arm64.zip and opencode-desktop-win-arm64.exe; no RTX Spark test is stated on the page.
caveats.zh-TW: 發行頁資產包含 opencode-windows-arm64.zip 與 opencode-desktop-win-arm64.exe；頁面沒有 RTX Spark 的測試說明。
